## DEUTZITAG: requesting details of purchase dispatches

**Sources on this page:** p81 A, p81 C. [Concise case study](../finance/deutzitag_dispatch_inquiries.md).

**Shared edition.** The following reading also discusses [p80 A](080.md#source-p80-a).

<a id="edition-cases-finance-deutzitag-dispatch-inquiries-deutzitag-requesting-details-of-purchase-dispatches"></a>



**Source edition: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro.** Childs p80 A and p81 A/C, printed heading 30 October 1918, received 31 October. Published `Oct28-31` key, unchanged. [Inputs](../../experiments/deutzitag_dispatch_inquiries/inputs.json), [exact certificates](../../experiments/deutzitag_dispatch_inquiries/certificates.json), [method](../../experiments/deutzitag_dispatch_inquiries/README.md).

The economic department of the Caucasus delegation is asked whether purchases have already been sent away, when and where further dispatches are expected, and how onward transport is intended. The request itself supplies no shipment answer.

<a id="edition-cases-finance-deutzitag-dispatch-inquiries-p80-a"></a>

### p80 A

[Source crop](../../experiments/deutzitag_dispatch_inquiries/sources/p80_A.png). Receipt `COS v LP (6.36 a.m., October 31st)`; origin `SS BERLIN 30/10 ... 1900`; addressee `KAUKASUS DELEGATION WIRTSCHAFTSABTEILUNG`. All 274 printed coordinates give this unedited 137-character body:

<details>
<summary>Raw decoded text</summary>

**Raw output:**

```text
DRAHTETOBVONEURENKAEUFENBEREITSABTRANSPORTEERFOLGTSINDEVENTUELLWANNUNDWOHINSOLCHEERFOLGENWERDENUNDWIEWEITERTRANSPORTGEDACHTISTXXDEUTZITAG
```

</details>

Reading: “Drahtet, ob von euren Käufen bereits Abtransporte erfolgt sind, eventuell wann und wohin solche erfolgen werden und wie Weitertransport gedacht ist. Deutzitag.”

<a id="edition-cases-finance-deutzitag-dispatch-inquiries-p81-a"></a>

### p81 A

[Source crop](../../experiments/deutzitag_dispatch_inquiries/sources/p81_A.png); [overprinted source glyph](../../experiments/deutzitag_dispatch_inquiries/sources/p81_A_overprint.png). Receipt `NKJ v LP (6.45 a.m., October 31st)`; origin `FUER COS SS BERLIN 30/10 B V K M KAUKASUS 1172`. All 338 coordinates are observed:

<details>
<summary>Raw decoded text</summary>

**Raw output:**

```text
FUERXSAULXWEINREICHXDOPPELPUNKTXDRAHTETJBVONEURENKAEUFENBEREITSABTRANSPORTEERFOLGTSINDEVENTUELLWANNUNDWOHINSOLCHEERFOLGENWERDENUNDWIEWEITERTRANSPORTGEDACHTISTXXDEUTZITAG
```

</details>

The received prefix is “Für Saul Weinreich:”. No independent personal identity is assigned. Source index 248 `G → F` changes the ordinary word `JB` to `OB`; the resulting suffix equals the complete p80 A and p81 C bodies at every coordinate pair. The corrected full candidate is:

<details>
<summary>Proposed text and exact labels</summary>

**Edited output:**

```text
FUERXSAULXWEINREICHXDOPPELPUNKTXDRAHTETOBVONEURENKAEUFENBEREITSABTRANSPORTEERFOLGTSINDEVENTUELLWANNUNDWOHINSOLCHEERFOLGENWERDENUNDWIEWEITERTRANSPORTGEDACHTISTXXDEUTZITAG
```

</details>

This is one local ciphertext repair. The published J label is not changed globally.

### Attribution and scope

Earlier unreviewed OCR-derived repository candidates already contained all three bodies. This edition adds source checking, independent physical witnesses, exact position comparisons and a costed repair. It makes no claim of first historical decipherment. The [adjacent pioneer-detachment order](#edition-cases-caucasus-tiflis-pioneer-detachment) is a separate military message.

<a id="edition-cases-caucasus-tiflis-pioneer-detachment"></a>

## A pioneer detachment may remain in Tiflis

**Sources on this page:** p81 B. [Concise case study](../caucasus/tiflis_pioneer_detachment.md).

<a id="edition-cases-caucasus-tiflis-pioneer-detachment-a-pioneer-detachment-may-remain-in-tiflis"></a>



**Source edition: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro.** Childs p81 B (PDF p84), 30 October 1918; published `Oct28-31` key, unchanged. [Source crop](../../experiments/deutzitag_dispatch_inquiries/sources/p81_B.png), [inputs](../../experiments/deutzitag_dispatch_inquiries/inputs.json), [exact certificate](../../experiments/deutzitag_dispatch_inquiries/certificates.json).

The clear header addresses General von Kress in Tiflis: `NKJ v LP (3.53 p.m., October 30th); FUER COS SS DD GR HQ OP 1400 (30/10); FUER GENERAL VON KRESS, TIFLIS`. This is a separate military message, unrelated to the commercial inquiries around it on the page.

<a id="edition-cases-caucasus-tiflis-pioneer-detachment-p81-b"></a>

### p81 B

All 132 source coordinates are observed. They decrypt directly to 66 fixed labels with no repair:

<details>
<summary>Raw decoded text</summary>

**Raw output:**

```text
ZUXNRX4452XPIONXABTXKANNINTIFLISBELASZENWERDENXGROENERXBX103830XO9
```

</details>

Reading: “Zu Nr. 4452: Pion.-Abt. kann in Tiflis belassen werden. Groener. B. 103830 O9.”

The received `BELASZEN`, `4452`, `BX103830XO9` and the final `O9` remain unchanged. The last field is not silently expanded to `OP`. The text permits the detachment to remain; it does not independently show what the unit subsequently did.

An earlier unreviewed repository candidate already contained this body. The present edition adds visual source checking, all coordinate and plaintext indices, re-encryption and an unchanged-reference inventory. It does not claim first historical decipherment.
